args.title: What happens when you open a web page
args.subtitle: From typing a URL to a rendered page, in about 200 ms

steps.title: Find the address
steps.text: The browser asks DNS which IP address belongs to the domain.

steps.title: Nearest edge
steps.text: A CDN close to you terminates TLS and answers static files from its cache.

steps.title: Your code runs
steps.text: Only cache misses reach the app server, which builds the page.

steps.title: Fetch the data
steps.text: Hot data comes from the cache; the database answers the rest.

steps.title: Defer slow work
steps.text: Emails and other slow jobs wait in a queue, so the page does not.
